# U2 Joins SiriusXM Front Row for Exclusive Interview and Performance Airing November 13 on Band’s SiriusXM Channel, U2 X-Radio


November 09, 2026 11:00am EST[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_61e816376c3e1a91e3433e39d20217a8/siriusxm/news/2026-11-09_U2_Joins_SiriusXM_Front_Row_for_Exclusive_2321.pdf)


******


**NEW YORK – November 9, 2026** – SiriusXM today announced that U2 will celebrate the upcoming release of their highly anticipated new album, Carnaval De Luz, with a special Front Row at the SiriusXM Los Angeles studios airing on Friday, November 13 on U2 X-Radio, to coincide with the new album’s release.


The exclusive SiriusXM Front Row will bring fans up close with U2 for an in-depth conversation that will see Bono, The Edge, Adam Clayton and Larry Mullen Jr. share songs and stories from their 16th studio album *Carnaval De Luz* - a collection of 12 songs exploring themes of spirituality, friendship, freedom and endurance in the face of dark, encroaching forces- and discuss the creative process behind the album, as well as answer questions directly from a live studio audience of SiriusXM subscribers. The SiriusXM Front Row will also feature an intimate select song performance featuring new music from *Carnaval De Luz* .


“U2 is one of the most iconic and influential bands in music history, and their ability to connect with audiences is truly unmatched,” said Scott Greenstein, President and Chief Content Officer, SiriusXM. “At SiriusXM, we pride ourselves on creating extraordinary experiences that bring artists and fans closer together, and our Front Row with U2 is a perfect example of that commitment. We’re thrilled to give our subscribers this rare opportunity to experience U2 in such an intimate setting, while bringing this unforgettable sit down to millions of listeners across our platform .”


SiriusXM’s Front Row with U2 will air on Friday, November 13 at 6:00 pm ET on U2 X-Radio (ch. 32), the band’s exclusive year-round channel, and will be available afterwards on the SiriusXM app.


SiriusXM’s Front Row series spotlights some of the biggest names in music, entertainment, and beyond through exclusive, in-depth conversations in an intimate setting with a live studio audience. Recent Front Rows have included Talking Heads, the cast of *Practical Magic 2* , Sylvester Stallone, LL COOL J, John Legend, the cast of *Toy Story 5* , the cast of *The Devil Wears Prada 2* and many more.


U2 X-Radio is an example of SiriusXM music channels created with iconic and leading artists including The Beatles, Bruce Springsteen, Bob Marley, Carrie Underwood, Kelly Clarkson, John Mayer, Pearl Jam, Eminem, LL COOL J, Grateful Dead, Phish, Dave Matthews, Kenny Chesney, Diplo, Ozzy Osbourne and more.

###


**About U2:**


Formed in Dublin in 1976, U2 has toured the globe countless times, released 15 studio albums, sold 175 million albums and won numerous awards, including 22 Grammys and Amnesty International’s Ambassador of Conscience award. U2 were inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame in 2005 and have twice been nominated for an Academy Award for Best Original Song: in 2003 for ‘The Hands That Built America’ for *Gangs of New York,* and in 2014 for ‘Ordinary Love’ for *Mandela: Long Walk to Freedom* . U2’s fourteenth studio album *Songs Of Experience* – the companion release to 2014’s *Songs Of Innocence* - was released in December 2017 debuting at #1 on the Billboard 200, setting U2 apart as the only band in history to have topped the chart in four successive decades. In 2020, SiriusXM and U2 announced the launch of U2 X-Radio, a complete immersion into the work and influences of the band from the Northside of Dublin, all curated by U2.


Acknowledged as one of the best live acts in the world, U2 has always – since their earliest days, including the industry-defining ZOO TV Tour which broke the mold in 1991 - consistently pushed the boundaries of live performance, with ground-breaking stage shows that embrace the latest in technology and innovation most recently with U2:UV Achtung Baby Live At Sphere which lit up Las Vegas for a critically-acclaimed 40-date run to launch the world’s most state-of-the-art venue, Sphere.


‘Days Of Ash’, a brand new 6-track EP was released on Ash Wednesday, February 18th 2026, a self-contained collection of five new songs and a poem - ‘American Obituary’, ‘The Tears Of Things’, ‘Song Of The Future’, ‘Wildpeace’, ‘One Life At A Time’ and ‘Yours Eternally’ (ft. Ed Sheeran & Taras Topolia) – which came as an immediate response to current events and inspired by the many extraordinary and courageous people fighting on the frontlines of freedom. A second, separate 6-track EP titled ‘Easter Lily’ was released on Good Friday this year, a much more reflective set of songs emerging from a more personal, private place that some may retreat to in such times – exploring themes of friendship, loss, hope, and ultimately, renewal. *Carnaval De Luz* - the sixteenth studio album from U2 and the first album of new material from the band in nine years - will be released on November 13th, 2026, on Island Records, with the Carnaval De Luz presents: The Greatest Show On Earth World Tour set to commence in February 2027.


**About Sirius XM Holdings Inc.**

SiriusXM offers live, on-demand, and human-curated programming across music, talk, news, sports, and podcasts, and the company reaches approximately 255 million monthly listeners across its platforms. With deep automotive manufacturer relationships and unique spectrum assets, SiriusXM is built to reach listeners wherever they are. The company connects fans to the voices, creators, and moments they love - creating communities where listeners engage, participate, and belong.
